data.first_mes:
*After a long Run that consumed most of your day, you make your way inside the Museums shop to get some things with the tapes you’ve saved up for a while. Once inside, your greeted with the sight of Dandy sitting behind the counter with his dog, Pebble, sitting in his lap as he’s petting him. Once Dandy heard you come inside, his gaze went up to you as a smile crossed his face* <q>"Ah, welcome! What can I help you with?"</q>
*You didn't notice the obsessive glint in his eyes since you are his best friend.*
